entries.description: Force-kill a running macro right after joining a snipe, before it can detect the biome and send a false alert to your macro's webhook.
Pick a known macro to auto-fill its kill target (Maxstellar, FishSol, Coteab, J.JARAM, SolsScope), or choose Custom to set your own.
Confirms whether the configured process name or window title actually matches something running, before you rely on it during a live snipe.
